Generated metric metadata for RESOLF counters and enum counters.

# Purpose
This file defines the metric metadata table for the `resolf` module. The `FD_METRICS_RESOLF` array lists each metric name and its type, and it also expands grouped enum metrics into separate counters for each result value. The entries cover stash operation outcomes, lookup table resolve results, blockhash expiration, transaction bundle peer failure, and database race events. The file is generated by `gen_metrics.py`, so it must not be edited by hand.
